elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9(c) requires $5,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance covering HDI's processing of customer data. The operative language expressly identifies such processing, so the condition is present and the required coverage is provided.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

result.reason: The operative provision meets every preferred requirement, and therefore also meets the lower fallback limits. It is not minimal because it additionally requires all coverage to continue for one year after the Agreement ends, a duration not required by either position. The added requirements remain insurance-related and do not contradict or impair the existing general provisions.
